name: hover-card

frames.best_why: Panel is open with the avatar loaded, the bio readable and the join date shown, clear of the cursor.

tagline: Hover a handle to float up a mini profile with avatar and bio.
summary: A line of small grey text credits an account, and the underlined handle opens a compact profile card on hover: portrait, handle, a short description and a join date.
appearance: One line of grey text on black reading 'Built and maintained by @origin_ui.', the handle underlined. Hovering it opens a dark rounded panel below with a circular portrait, the handle in white, a two-line bio and a small calendar line.
behaviour: Hovering or focusing the underlined handle fades and zooms in the profile panel, and moving away fades it out. The portrait pops into the panel a moment after it opens.
demo_content: The sentence 'Built and maintained by @origin_ui.' and a profile of that handle with 'Joined December 2023'.
search_phrases: profile preview when you hover a name
popup card with a person's details
info panel that appears on hover
small bio card over a link
floating panel with avatar and join date
use_when: A name or handle needs a glanceable profile without sending the reader to another page.
avoid_when: It opens on hover or focus only, so touch users may never see the card at all.
customise: Wrap your trigger and panel as children; open and close delays, alignment, side offset and the optional arrow are props, while panel width and content are yours.
weight_why: One small panel that fetches a single portrait only when it opens.

a11y.note: The panel has no dialog or tooltip role, the trigger has no focus ring, and its zoom and fade ignore reduced motion.

issues: Frames 3 to 5 show the panel with an empty gap where the avatar should be
The panel's dark fill barely separates from the black page
polish_why: Compact profile preview with a clear layout; the dark panel and empty-avatar frames weaken it.
